title: Reducing the Cost of Qudit State Preparation by Learning a Sparse Structure for SNAP Gates
abstract: arXiv:2610.21557v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Preparing quantum states in bosonic qudits with SNAP--Displacement sequences requires both optimizing the gate parameters and deciding which Fock levels should be controlled by each SNAP gate. A fully parameterized ansatz assigns an independent phase to every Fock level in every gate, leading to a number of phases that grows steeply. This constitutes a problem for short to medium term systems as controlling many phases requires complex control pulses which are subject to increased control errors. Previous work reduced this cost by restricting the trainable phases to predefined sparse patterns, such as a diagonal or a grid, which however may not be optimal for a specific target state. In this work, we address this limitation by introducing a method that learns which phases are needed together with their values, using a differentiable mask. translated_title: 通过学习SNAP门的稀疏结构降低量子位态制备的成本
translated_abstract: 使用SNAP-位移序列在玻色量子位中制备量子态，既需要优化门参数，又需要决定每个SNAP门应控制哪些福克能级。完全参数化的拟设为每个门中的每个福克能级分配一个独立的相位，导致相位数量急剧增长。这对中短期系统构成了一个问题，因为控制大量相位需要复杂的控制脉冲，而这些脉冲容易受到更大的控制误差影响。先前的工作通过将可训练相位限制在预定义的稀疏模式（如对角线或网格模式）中来降低这一成本，但对于特定目标态而言，这些模式可能并非最优。在本工作中，我们通过引入一种使用可微分掩码的方法来解决这一限制，该方法可以学习哪些相位是必需的以及它们的取值。稀疏性惩罚项促使去除不必要的相位，而温度退火则逐步……（摘要截断）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于可微分掩码的方法，可自动学习SNAP门中所需的相位参数及其取值，通过稀疏性约束显著减少玻色量子位态制备中需要控制的相位数量，从而降低控制成本和误差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a differentiable mask-based method that jointly learns which SNAP gate phases are necessary and their values, using sparsity penalties to reduce the number of controlled phases and thus lowering the cost of quantum state preparation in bosonic qudits.
